view: Aquileia Roman river port ruins long straight stone quay edging dry grass-covered former channel, close view of worn mooring stone with hole foreground, low masonry warehouse foundations behind and poplar trees, no modern boats or broad blue sea, no intact city skyline.

eras.title: Beside the old river port
eras.caption: Long stone quays and mooring remains mark Aquileia's Roman river port. The channel has changed, but the waterfront still shows how goods could pass between inland routes and the Adriatic through this northern Italian city.
